title.zh: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
title.en: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks

current_state.zh: The SEC's Division of Examinations named 'super intelligence' and tokenization as areas of heightened scrutiny in its FY2027 priorities, signaling increased compliance attention for broker-dealers, advisers, and transfer agents handling AI tools and tokenized products.
current_state.en: The SEC's Division of Examinations named 'super intelligence' and tokenization as areas of heightened scrutiny in its FY2027 priorities, signaling increased compliance attention for broker-dealers, advisers, and transfer agents handling AI tools and tokenized products.
